title: Terrorists Kill Two Non-Local Labourers at Kulgam Brick Kiln
detail: On July 31, 2026, unidentified terrorists opened fire on two non-local labourers at a brick kiln in Kilam village, Kulgam district, South Kashmir — the first attack on civilians in the Valley since the April 2025 Pahalgam massacre. The victims, identified as Deepak (Chhattisgarh) and Bopinder (Uttar Pradesh), were migrant workers; Deepak died at the scene while Bopinder succumbed to critical injuries at a Srinagar hospital despite treatment. Security forces cordoned off the area and launched search operations to trace the attackers. The attack triggered panic among the tens of thousands of migrant labourers from India's poorer northern states who work seasonally in Kashmir's construction, road, brick-kiln, and orchard sectors between March and November, echoing the targeted-killing pattern of previous Kulgam attacks in 2006 and 2019.

media.caption: Security forces cordon off the Kilam brick-kiln attack site in Kulgam district after two non-local labourers were shot dead
